system_definition.canonical_center: V2 is the sole canonical governance / truth convergence / dispatch arbitration / closure authority center.
system_definition.bounded_subject: Android is a bounded relative subject runtime with local lifecycle, local AI consumption, local execution judgment, and local visible surfaces, but no global truth finalization or global dispatch authority.

canonical_center_boundary.summary: Canonical center boundary is V2-only and non-parallel.

bounded_subject_boundary.summary: Bounded subject runtime authority remains local and non-sovereign.

participant_governance_boundary.summary: Participant lifecycle state transitions are center-authorized only.

observability_diagnostics_evidence_bound.summary: Observability and diagnostics are classification/evidence layers, not parallel authority.

outward_consumption_boundary.summary: Outward surfaces are consumption-only and must not reassemble authority.

canonical_center_boundary.summary: V2 is the sole canonical governance center for ingest, routing, dispatch authority, truth convergence, participant governance, closure, operator governance plane, outward truth compilation, and observability contract definition.

truth_convergence_boundary.summary: Truth convergence finalization is center-owned; participant runtimes contribute evidence/signals but do not finalize canonical truth.

dispatch_governance_closure_boundary.summary: Dispatch legality, participant governance, and multi-subject closure semantics remain center-authorized and must converge through canonical contracts.

observability_diagnostics_evidence_bound.summary: Observability/diagnostics/evidence contracts classify and uplink evidence; they are not a parallel authority or parallel canonical center.

outward_consumption_projection_boundary.summary: Outward/operator/projection/panel surfaces are consumption/projection/operation-facing layers only and must not reassemble authority.

stable_quasi_platform_state_definition.summary: V2 is in a stable quasi-platform state with fixed canonical governance and bounded-subject contracts, and is explicitly not a fully mature distributed platform.
